info.name: Nicoflow API
info.description:
Full Nicoflow API collection — verified against the live chi route table (2026-07-10).

**Setup:** import this + set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:8080). Run **Auth › Login** first — it captures `accessToken` into a collection variable, so every protected request just works.

Response envelope: `{ "data": <T>, "error": null }` on success; `{ "data": null, "error": { "code", "message" } }` on error.

Folders tagged **⚠ STUB 501** hit routes whose handlers return `501 not implemented` — request shapes are placeholders for when they land.

request.description: Liveness probe. No auth.

item.name: Auth

request.description: Register. 201. Email-verify scaffolded, not enforced — token returned empty; log in separately for a token.
Login by email OR username via `identifier`. Captures accessToken + refreshToken into collection vars.
Uses the HttpOnly refresh cookie set by login. No body needed in-browser; Postman sends the cookie automatically.
Idempotent. Authenticates off the HttpOnly refresh cookie, not the access token. 204.
Revokes ALL refresh tokens for the user. Needs a live access token.
Always 200 (no user enumeration). Emails a reset token.
Single-use, 1-hour TTL token. Revokes all refresh tokens on success.
Verifies email via token. Scaffolded — not enforced at login yet.
Re-sends the verification email. Always 200 (no enumeration).
⚠ STUB — FIDO2/WebAuthn in v2. Returns 501 not implemented.

request.description: All fields optional. theme ∈ light|dark|system; language ∈ en|he|ru.

item.name: Areas

request.description: Areas each with their nested projects — the /areas board payload.
Free plan: max 3 → PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED on the 4th. Captures areaId.

item.description: Area = top-level bucket of responsibility. Free: 3, Pro: unlimited.

item.name: Projects

request.description: Free plan: 5 projects TOTAL → PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. Captures projectId.
Set areaId:null to detach from its area (moves to Inbox).

item.description: Projects live in an Area. dueDate is project-only (tasks have no hard due date).

item.name: Tasks

request.description: sortField ∈ displayOrder|scheduledFor|priority|title|createdAt|energy. sortOrder ∈ asc|desc. Unknown → 400 INVALID_INPUT.
scheduledFor is the ONLY date (soft). No hard dueDate — sending one is stripped. Captures taskId.
Cross-user access → 404 TASK_NOT_FOUND (no existence leak).
Absent field = untouched; explicit null = clear (notes/scheduledFor/estimatedMinutes/url).
status ∈ inbox|active|someday|done|cancelled. done sets completedAt.
Set/clear the soft date + rollsOver. Past + rollsOver=true → carries to Today (never overdue). scheduledFor:null clears it.
Drag-and-drop reorder within a project.
Cascades to subtasks (FK ON DELETE CASCADE).

item.description: Tasks live in a Project. Free plan: 50 live tasks/project.

item.name: Time Spread & Focus

request.description: Buckets active+inbox tasks → today/tomorrow/thisWeek in the given IANA tz. Past+rollsOver=true carries to today. Unknown tz → 400 INVALID_INPUT. Empty tz → UTC. (No from/to params.)
Deterministic ranked 'what can I do right now?' list. Past+rolling ranks first.
